content: Mii orentula, eneshi bi tande huaisan ji 2 hui xin wo. Ene ghua xin dunda tai qixin giezhi loushi zhugheitai olodoghane giezho.
Zhiguitu xienzhila melie kieliesan kielienyi, pse tai shitulai tungo giezhi Ezhan, yeshijiu jiuichen ogisan minlinyi tai jila ireghane giezho.
Ta mejieku zui zhunyonishi ene wo, duya baraku xienzide uzhezhi xiniechen kunla khizhedene duranghalane giezhi uzhezhi xiniezhi
"Ersa irene giezhi dain giesan khala wine? Mai xienrenla fugusanse eli kutula yanyanjila man wine, zui melieshida zhayaghasanghala niekielien wo." giezhi kieliene.
Hhela eqighandei Hudai kielienghala asimanni giesei, pse zemin ususe khizhezhi usughala gholusei nanxighan matazho.
Hhe shihouku duyani usughala manjidene widaghawoma,
edeku asiman, zeminni yen Hudai kielienghala feilieghazhi xienlian witu kunlai panjizhi widaghaku hhe udu kurune. Hhe shihoude asiman, zeminni khanghala tulie widaghane.
Mii orentula, enei ta bu mata, Ezhan uzhese niudushi 1000 nien wo, 1000 nienshi niudu wo.
Ezhan niezhan kunla sumulasan mutun dain giesanne danwu giezhi ulie chenjighakui pusho. Shijishan hhe tai rennai giezhi nieda ulie widaghadene jien kunlai geizhen gieghaku duran wo.
Ezhanni udu ghughei mutun irene. Hhe udude nie fugie shenqi irese asiman wida khine. Asiman jieredulai khanghala tulie widaghane. Zemin, zemin jiere giesanlai man widaghane.
Yanyanjila man ingie widase ta matunie kun danlane? Ta indan zhiguide, xienliande udu daokuni wo.
Hudai udui panjizhi ghujighan ire gie. Hhe udu kuzhese asimanyi khan tulie widaghane, asiman jieredulai tulie xiui widaghane.
Matan Huda dain giesan mutun gundanni durusan shini asiman, shini zeminni sagheizho.
Ingiese mii orentula, ta ene shiqinlai sagheise xiacha giezhi goyane bu zannanshighadene yama kheilakui wizhi Hudare heqishi.
Mai Ezhan rennai giekushi jiuiku jihui wo giezhi sumula. Zhen matan oresan gaijiu Baolo zhao Huda hhende ogisan aghelighala tande xin huaisan mutun wo.
Hhei xinla jiere man enezighan shiqinlai kieliezho. Xin jiere niezhanlai dunjireku chijiashi erlin witu, undan witu kunla psedu jinwun mutun codazhi lijie giedene goyane widaghawo.
Ingiese mii orentula, ta enei eqighan mejiese goude xioxin gie. Pse mouxien kunlai codasan tai miidene goya undanlasan oronsene anda boune.
Ta mai Ezhan, yeshijiu jiuichen Ersa Mexihani nenjien, taniku jiere henda. Kuaikui edese chanqi hhende ogi. Amine!
